package.name: mediaservo_control_relay
package.description: MSRTC cockpit teleop → ROS2 bridge sample (the device-day face of the G5 three layers): via the mediaservo-client C++ SDK (the sdk-client package's components/client) it establishes a control DataChannel and forwards receipts as the ROS topic /mediaservo/ack; commands are injected via the ROS topic /mediaservo/cmd (seq increments in-process). Build prerequisite: the sdk-client package installed (libmediaservo_client + headers; see the in-package README).
